Holder Eubel Brady & Suttman Asset Management Has Increased General Electric Co (GE) Stake; Sta Wealth Management Cut Holding in Conocophillips (COP) by $525,631 as Market Valuation Rose
June 29, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Eubel Brady & Suttman Asset Management Inc increased its stake in General Electric Co (GE) by 100.95% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eubel Brady & Suttman Asset Management Inc bought 408,827 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 813,825 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.97 million, up from 404,998 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eubel Brady & Suttman Asset Management Inc who had been investing in General Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $120.12 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.93% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $13.83. About 64.43M shares traded.
